kXqFNIC|I?ET-LR`928r.text:
Change all the "voice" sound clips to your own character's voice, using reference from the voice clip's name!

ADVICE FOR MAKING VOICE CLIPS:

SafeVoice: A happy noise your character may make when they reach safety. I recommend you make this about one second long and not to make it too loud, since it's meant to be subtle.

SquishedVoice: Your character's yell of pain when they are caught under the compactor and KO'd. I usually make this a muffled "ouch" or "eek"

WinVoice: What your character says when they win! I have no advice for this, just put on a joyful voice and say your character's winning quip! Yes, you're the BEST!
